'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Iran–Israel conflict during the Syrian civil war]]
***An [[Israel]]i [[airstrike]] in [[Baniyas]], [[Syria]], kills three people, including an [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]] official. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/3/1/iran-revolutionary-guard-member-and-two-others-killed-in-attack-in-syria (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**Four [[Mexican Armed Forces|Mexican soldiers]] are killed by an [[improvised explosive device]] in a trap near [[Aguililla]], [[Michoacán]], [[Mexico]]. The soldiers were inspecting a camp, likely used by cartel members, when they stepped on an [[anti-personnel mine]] set in the underbrush. [https://apnews.com/article/mexico-cartels-soldiers-killed-lopez-obrador-beaaf0bf57f061f6b1d9fa0fcf3ea86c (AP)]
*[[War in Amhara]]
**Intense fighting between the [[Fano (militia)|Fano]] militia and the [[Ethiopia]]n government breaks out in [[Bahir Dar]], the capital of the [[Amhara Region]]. [https://www.theeastafrican.co.ke/tea/rest-of-africa/fighting-returns-to-capital-of-ethiopia-s-amhara-region-4542246 (The East African)]
*At least eight people are injured when a suspected homemade bomb explodes in a cafe in [[Bengaluru]], [[Karnataka]], [[India]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/india/blast-cafe-indias-bengaluru-injures-4-media-reports-say-2024-03-01/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Haitian crisis (2018–present)|Haitian crisis]]
**The G9 gang launches an offensive in [[Port-au-Prince]], [[Haiti]], with its leader [[Jimmy Chérizier]] announcing the aim of capturing Haiti's cabinet officials and police chief. Four police officers are killed in a shooting outside a police station. [https://apnews.com/article/haiti-gangs-violence-barbecue-police-prime-minister-c275da3b420f018a95099c9e6539e61f (AP)]
**[[President of Kenya|Kenyan president]] [[William Ruto]] announces an agreement with Haiti to deploy 1,000 police officers as part of a mission approved by the [[United Nations]] to combat [[gang violence]] in the Caribbean nation. [https://www.reuters.com/world/kenya-haiti-sign-agreement-allowing-police-deployment-2024-03-01/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*A [[German Army|soldier]] kills four people in a [[Spree killer|spree shooting]] in [[Scheeßel]] and [[Bothel, Lower Saxony|Bothel]], [[Lower Saxony]], [[Germany]], before being arrested. [https://apnews.com/article/germany-shooting-soldier-suspect-bd86b32ed349291cd37517cbb8c15b57 (AP)]
*Nineteen people, including six children, are injured in a [[vehicle-ramming attack]] in [[Szczecin]], [[Poland]]. [https://www.barrons.com/news/17-injured-as-car-drives-into-crowd-in-polish-city-of-szczecin-official-a3b7a883 (Barron's)]
*[[Iran]]ian [[Grammy Awards|Grammy]] winner [[Shervin Hajipour]] is sentenced to up to four years in jail and is ordered to write [[Anti-Americanism|anti-American]] music. [https://www.rferl.org/a/iranian-grammy-winner-sentenced-to-prison-writing-music-anti-u-s-music/32844200.html (RFE/RL)]

**[[Alexander Stubb]] is sworn in as the 13th [[President of Finland]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/finland-inaugurates-alexander-stubb-president-nato-era-2024-03-01/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 Iranian legislative election]]
**[[Elections in Iran|Parliamentary elections]] are held in [[Iran]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/2/29/what-to-expect-as-iran-heads-to-polls-in-double-elections (Al Jazeera)]
